nav.adminUsers.label: Users
actions.openAdminUsers.label: Admin users
actions.openAdminUsers.description: Accounts that can sign in to the Admin UI
errors.ADMIN_AUTHENTICATION_THROTTLED: Too many incorrect passwords or codes were entered for this account, so further attempts are paused. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.ADMIN_AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable because a service it depends on is not responding. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, contact whoever runs this platform.
errors.ADMIN_USER_ROLE_REQUIRED: An administrator account must hold a role. Choose a role for this account.
errors.NEW_PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password is the same as the current one. Choose a different password.
errors.ADMIN_USER_OUTRANKS_ACTOR: This account's role holds permissions your own role does not ({permissions}), so you cannot change it, set its password, deactivate it or delete it.
errors.ADMIN_USER_AVATAR_NOT_FOUND: The avatar must be an image from the library. Choose it again.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED_FOR_ROLE_TWO_FACTOR: This role cannot require two-step verification on this instance.
This role cannot require two-step verification while two-step verification (the MFA module) is switched off. Switch it on first, then save the role again.

This role cannot require two-step verification because no second factor can be set up on this instance: the encryption key MFA_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not configured. Ask whoever runs this platform to set it.
roles.twoFactor.help: Administrators with this role must sign in with a second factor; those who have not set one up are asked to at their next sign-in.
roles.twoFactor.mfaOff: Two-step verification is switched off, so this requirement is not applied now; it applies again when two-step verification is switched back on.
roles.twoFactor.confirmSignOut: Administrators with this role who have not set up two-step verification: {count}. They will be signed out now and asked to set it up at their next sign-in. Continue?
roles.twoFactor.signedOut: Saved role {code}. Administrators signed out because they have not set up two-step verification: {count}.
roles.twoFactor.notice.encryption_key_mi: Not in force: no encryption key (MFA_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY).
